'''Rod Latham Nudj-revo''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/deck00g.htm Nudj-revo], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]).
